chapter: Early heroes and Kid Ory band
title: Playing with Kid Ory's band and its members
summary: He once sat in with Kid Ory's band on mandolin and lists its men: Chip Matthews, Stonewall, Johnny Dot, Eddie Gardner, Henry Martin and Koochie Martin.
